cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Tell the manager we agreed I'd cover the morning, not the evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then you have no conflicting memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain?
